links.outcome: Accuracy of ChatGPT staging and treatment recommendations versus NCCN guidelines, including omitted neck dissection
links.effect: 95% accurate for first-line treatment; 55% inaccurate staging; neck dissection omitted in 50%; 40% of treatment recommendations deemed unnecessary.
links.quote: Whereas ChatGPT's responses were 95% accurate at recommending the correct first-line treatment based on the 2021 NCCN guidelines, 55% of the responses contained inaccurate staging.

links.outcome: Output accuracy against expert-scored NCCN reference standard
links.effect: 55% of responses had inaccurate staging; neck dissection incorrectly omitted in 50%; 40% of treatment recommendations unnecessary.
links.quote: Neck dissection was incorrectly omitted from treatment recommendations in 50% of the cases.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT-3.5 on 40 clinical vignettes for head and neck mucosal malignancy staging and treatment recommendations, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
